lines: Led by the wannabe "bad girl" Taimanin Kozuki Sana, we made our way toward the Underground City Yomihara.
So, Sana-san, what exactly will we do on this mission?
We only heard up to the point of infiltrating Yomihara from Asagi-sensei.

Shikanosuke: Eh?
Me: Huh?
Hebiko: You don't know?
Sana looked at our shocked expressions and laughed heartily.
I mean, my job is only to guide you guys to Yomihara. Ask someone on the ground there if you wanna know the rest.
So there are other Taimanin who already infiltrated the city?
Seems like it. The plan is for them to contact us once we've arrived.
It was a widely used method for undercover missions.
Each agent was given as little information as possible in case they were captured by enemies.
As I was thinking to myself, someone lightly tugged at my clothes.
Hey, Fuma, what is this place...? It's dark and creepy... is Yomihara really just beyond here...?
It was Shikanosuke. I supposed it was because he had always been afraid of the dark, but today his jumpiness was above and beyond.
Nope. I wouldn't say "beyond here," because Yomihara is 300 meters below ground, so we need to go deeper.
We were walking through the new outer flood bypass for the capital region located beneath Tokyo.
It was a structure that had been built 100 meters underground, even farther down than the capital region's 50-meter deep original outer flood bypass.
It had been being built as a guard against local disasters, but the plan had stalled out midway.
At present, the unfinished project lay neglected, and...
...it was pretty much the only way to reach the lawless, underground city of Yomihara, located 300 meters below Tokyo.
What, are you scared, Shikanosuke? Your voice is trembling.
It's j-just... 300 meters... is too deep, don't you think!? Why is it in a place like that!?
Shikanosuke-chan. That's because there's a Gate to the Devildom down there.
Yes. It's an accessway to the Devildom from the human world, rumored to be in the deepest part of Yomihara.
Which is why Yomihara is called "the closest city to the Devildom in Japan"ー
Eight out of ten residents are from the Devildom, and I've heard they are constantly struggling for power...
I guess in a way, it's a more dangerous city than Tokyo Kingdom.
In other words, Yomihara was the human world's trade port with the Devildom.
The profits to be had there were far beyond those of Tokyo Kingdom, and that alone led to dangerous people gathering.
Eeeeeehhhhh!!!? More dangerous than Tokyo Kingdom????
B-But... my stomach started hurting so I'll head to the bathroom for a bit...
Ahaha!! You guys are overreacting! Once we get there, you'll see that Yomihara isn't that different from other cities.
Sana joined the conversation, putting an arm around the terrified Shikanosuke's shoulder.
Really, really. I've actually gone undercover there and returned many times.
I-I see... Then I guess we're safe...
Well, some of the partners I went there with are dead though. Ahaha!
Shikanosuke was almost crying. It certainly wasn't a laughing matter.
Nah, it only happens once in a while. Listen, calm down, Shikanosuke. Here, have a drink.
As she spoke, Sana-san took out a drink can and showed it to us.
I mean, even if you tell him to calm down... And wait a minute, that's... alcohol, isn't it?
In response to my skeptical expression, Sana-san tilted her head as if to say, "What's the problem?"
LiLiTH Super Strong!! Man, it's really good.
There's no way a student can drink alcohol!
Unfazed by what I said, Sana-san thrust the can in my direction while laughing.
You're a student, but also a Taimanin. It's alright, it's alright.
I replied in disbelief, but Sana-san just smirked without any concerns.
What, Fuma, are you the serious type? It goes down surprisingly easy and tastes great.
I mean, to begin with, we are on a mission right now...
You are all so stiff, you know that. The only thing I want to be stiff is "that thing," ahahaha!!
(H-Hey, Fuma!? She's super cute, but she acts like an old dude!!!)
(Y-Yeah... It's too late now, but something about this mission stinks to high heaven...!!)
Shikanosuke and I were abuzz with discussion of whether or not we were going to be okay working with this person, in more ways than one...
Sana-san!! Please don't pull Fuma-chan and Shikanosuke-chan down the wrong path!!
As expected. Hebiko, who had the qualities of a class representative, sternly warned Sana-san.
The wrong path? That's just mean. LiLiTH Super Strong is nice and tasty~
It's not about the alcohol being nice and tasty or whatever! Besides, this is a mission right now. Be a bit more serious.
Hehe, it's alright. I'm serious when I have to be. More importantly, Hebiko...
You're so angry... I wonder why? Wait, is it that!!?
Sana-san snickered to herself and walked closer to Hebiko.
Ehehe... which one, I wonder~? Fuma? Or Shikanosuke?
R-Really! Hebiko doesn't know what you're talking about!!
For some reason Hebiko turned red and rushed ahead of us.
Ahaha! Hebiko~ wait! Let's have a heart-to-heart girl talk~♪ I'm fine with the one left over!
Sana-san followed after her, already in an unpleasant and intoxicated state.
Hmmm. I don't really get it, but she's astounding, in a variety of ways...
We nodded to each other with serious faces. And at that moment...
I had accidentally kicked something that looked like an empty can of juice.
It was probably the can of LiLiTH Super Strong that Sana-san had tried to give us.
But for some reason it was empty.
There was no one around us.
I followed after the others, tilting my head.
After walking for a bit, Sana-san's relaxed expression became tense.
Guys, proceed with caution from here on. It's gonna get a bit dangerous.
...Are you talking about those lights over there?
I peered into the darkness. The vast underground flood bypass was dotted here and there with inexplicable lights.
Those are Armed Refugees. They up and settled in this flood bypass and claimed it as their territory. If you provoke them, things'll get messy.
Yeah. They're genuinely dangerous. With the financial crisis on the mainland, people are washing ashore here in large numbers, from the poor to criminals.
They have nowhere to go on the surface, so they claimed this hole in the ground.
You're right, they do look dangerous...
That's because their backs are against the wall. Murder, kidnapping, robbery... they'll do anything for money.
But I've already cleared it with them, so we'll be fine as long as we don't do anything unnecessary.
Sana-san had infiltrated Yomihara many times, so she must have known how to handle things.
I gave them a good amount. It's what you would call a "necessary expense."
While we were talking quietly, a group of Armed Refugees appeared from the darkness.
The Armed Refugees were pointing their guns at us and there was a hint of disquiet in the air.
The atmosphere was not welcoming at all.
Hey, Mister Wang!! Let us through your territory.
Sana-san called out in a friendly manner to the man who looked to be their leader.
She must have sensed their hostility the same way we had, but she didn't show it in her behavior at all.
Oh... Look who it is, the young lady Taimanin.
If you understand, then could you lower your guns? It's so friggin' terrifying I'm gonna wet my pants.
Heehee... I'd love to do that, but I also want to do this...
Sana's expression changed. She slowly reached for the weapon on her shoulder.
Hey, dude, are you for real...?
The sense of murderous intent swelledー
This is bad!! Hebiko, Shikanosuke, scatter!!

Shikanosuke: Aieeeeeee!!! I knew this was going to happen!!!
Hebiko: Yes!!
At almost the same time as my yell, there was loud gunfire all around usー
We moved and took cover, right before being fired on by the Armed Refugees under Wang's command.
What the hell do those bastards think they're doing!?
Heehee, the toll has gone up!! Especially for you lot!!!
